config.section.automation.name: Automation Features
config.auto-harvest.name: Enable Auto-Harvest (Non-Vanilla)
config.auto-harvest.tooltip: Allows hoppers placed below a machine (Y - 1) to automatically pull and harvest finished products downward into the hopper.
config.chest-output-transfer.name: Transfer to Chest Below (Non-Vanilla)
config.chest-output-transfer.tooltip: Allows hoppers to automatically transfer collected items downward into a regular chest or mini-shipping bin placed directly below them (Y + 1).
config.periodic-processing.name: Background Periodic Automation (Non-Vanilla)
config.periodic-processing.tooltip: Allows hoppers to continuously check and process machines in the background without requiring player interaction or menu closures.
config.process-interval.name: Processing Interval (Ticks)
config.process-interval.tooltip: How frequently in game ticks background automation checks run. (60 ticks = 1 real-world second).
config.section.machines.name: Special Machine Handling
config.service-crab-pots.name: Crab Pot Automation (Non-Vanilla)
config.service-crab-pots.tooltip: Allows hoppers to automatically load bait into crab pots below (Y + 1) and collect catches from crab pots above (Y - 1).
config.service-casks.name: Cask Automation (Non-Vanilla)
config.service-casks.tooltip: Allows hoppers to load aging ingredients into casks below (Y + 1) and harvest finished aged products from casks above (Y - 1).
config.section.customization.name: Hopper Customization
config.hopper-capacity.name: Hopper Inventory Capacity (Non-Vanilla)
config.hopper-capacity.tooltip: Total storage capacity of the hopper (36 slots vanilla default, or 70 slots expanded like Big Chest).
config.sound-effects.name: Play Sound Effects
config.sound-effects.tooltip: Plays subtle sound effects when items are automatically loaded into machines below or harvested from machines above.
